items.detail: Clark already has the most 20-point, 10-assist games in WNBA history. But her game remains a work in progress.

items.headline: Ohio St. shifts senior day celebration to opener
items.detail: Ohio State is shifting its senior day celebration from its traditional spot in the regular-season home finale all the way to the season opener on Sept. 5.

items.headline: Royals' Cameron throws 1-hit shutout at Angels
items.detail: Noah Cameron just kept going after losing his bid for a no-hitter in the seventh inning -- all the way to the final pitch of the afternoon.

items.headline: Dodgers place starter Wrobleski on injured list
items.detail: Justin Wrobleski, a 26-year-old left-hander who is 11-5 with a 3.56 ERA, was placed on the injured list Sunday with what the Los Angeles Dodgers are calling forearm inflammation, prompting reliever Kyle Hurt to be called up to take his spot on the roster.

items.headline: Counsell: Swanson headed to IL after Cubs' loss
items.detail: Shortstop Dansby Swanson left Sunday's 11-4 loss to the St. Louis Cardinals because of left side discomfort after an awkward swing-and-miss in the bottom of the third inning, and will be put on the injured list, Chicago Cubs manager Craig Counsell said.

items.headline: 😆 Mets troll Jayden Daniels over No. 5 dispute
items.detail: The team is the latest to poke fun at Daniels over his jersey number dispute with his alma mater, LSU.

items.headline: 10-man Lens shock PSG to win French Super Cup
items.detail: Lens overcame a first-half red card for defender Kyllian Antonio to battle to a 1-0 win over Paris Saint-Germain in the Trophee de Champions at Stade Bollaert-Delelis.

items.headline: What will Mourinho's Real Madrid starting XI look like with six new signings?
items.detail: Real Madrid have responded to a second season without a major trophy with a slew of big summer signings. How will coach José Mourinho fit them all in?

items.headline: Transfer rumors, news: Barcelona eye Arsenal striker Viktor Gyökeres
items.detail: Barcelona are considering a move for Arsenal striker Viktor Gyökeres. Transfer Talk has the latest.
